rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday way to say someone is very interested and keen.

example.english: I’m an avid fan of baking and even bought a recipe book.
example.traditional: 我好有興趣整蛋糕，仲買咗本食譜添。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3 zing2 daan6 gou1 zung6 maai5 zo2 bun2 sik6 pou2 tim1

rows.note: Use this when the enthusiasm is focused on a particular activity or subject.

example.english: They are an avid student of local history.
example.traditional: 佢一向熱衷於研究本地歷史。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 jit6 cung1 jyu1 jin4 gau3 bun2 dei6 lik6 si2

rows.note: Use this for especially intense enthusiasm, such as an avid fan or supporter.

example.english: They are an avid football fan and attend every match.
example.traditional: 佢係個狂熱球迷，場場波都入場睇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 go3 kong4 jit6 kau4 mai4 coeng4 coeng4 bo1 dou1 jap6 coeng4 tai2
